1.consolidated_definition: alim. Suministro de comida. Servicio de entremeses o comidas preparadas. Anglicismo crudo, usual. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. Tía Rosa tenía un catering de comidas francesas que, gracias a un enchufe de línea directa con el Departamento de Hacienda que le encargaba la comida de las recepciones en la Fortaleza, le devengaba un ingreso de por lo menos cincuenta mil dólares al año
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Food supply. Service of hors d'oeuvres or prepared meals. Raw anglicism, usual. 

Note: La Fortaleza is the official residence and administrative seat of the Governor of Puerto Rico, a historic fort located in Old San Juan.

 Catering service provided by Tía Rosa featured French cuisine, which earned her at least $50,000 per year thanks to a connection with the Department of the Treasury that contracted her for food services at receptions held at La Fortaleza.
